name: morpho-builder
description: Build and review Morpho Vault V2 Earn, Blue variable-rate borrow, and Midnight fixed-rate, fixed-maturity borrow integrations with REST reads, Actions API transactions, Merkl rewards, product-specific UX and safety, plus GraphQL-to-REST migration guidance

interface.longDescription: Guidance for developers building and reviewing Morpho Vault V2 Earn with Vault V1 compatibility, Blue variable-rate borrowing and Midnight fixed-rate, fixed-maturity borrowing. Uses REST reads, Actions API transactions and Merkl rewards, with UX, safety and review checkers. Includes a migration skill to audit existing GraphQL reads and legacy transaction builders, map REST replacements and verify changed outputs with explicit gaps. Actions API keys stay server-side. This plugin contains skills only; it does not connect to an MCP server or execute transactions.
capabilities: Morpho Vault V2: build/review earn integrations where users deposit loan assets (e.g. stablecoins) to earn yield
Morpho Blue: build/review variable-rate market integrations for stablecoin loans against crypto collateral
Morpho Midnight: build/review fixed-rate, fixed-maturity borrowing integrations on supported chains
Migration: audit existing GraphQL integrations, map consumed fields to REST, replace legacy transaction builders with Actions and verify outputs with explicit gaps
